keyFindings.description: The merge brought main's Dispatch outbox role forward, which waits for the holder's empty receipt unless the holder has a serving port (streamAck: entry.Port != 0). This PR removes every receipt the plugins sent and every agent-subject subscription, so for every portless holder (every Oh My Pi and Claude Code session) the wait never ends: the event is recorded failed with ErrReceiptTimeout, counted unanswered, retried on every back-off past the dead-letter count, the owner's later events held behind it (batch.go:589, :594, :598-603), and published_destinations never records the role, while the holder does receive the one stored copy. Both review agents reproduced it on a scratch copy with a real NATS and Postgres. async.go:47-49 already says no role forward answers it. Count a role forward reached on the stream's acknowledgement for every holder (AcceptStreamAck true, streamAck and its Port branch deleted); rewrite the stand-ins that answer receipts (outbox role_test.go:225, :525 and the :590-614 premise, order_test.go:257, throughput_test.go:350, core_denied_test.go:88, cmd/dispatch multiprocess_test.go:490-498, outbox_load_steps_test.go:378-386); correct AGENTS.md:2728, :2742 (which contradicts :2563), :4024, cmd/dispatch/README.md:606 and :2040-2041, cmd/dispatch/main.go:503's metric help, THROUGHPUT.md; then remove the receipt branch of Request, AcceptStreamAck and ErrReceiptTimeout if nothing calls them.

carrying reads the gap only from the previous pass's outcome, so created-with-gap, then a serving-port pass that gets no consumer, then a pass that finds it answers gap:false (both agents reproduced it; f7fdb91f kept it through the carry c01d14e9 removed). Keep a gap flag in registerSession that only turns on and stamp it on the final answer; add the three-pass case. Correct api.go:1501-1502 ('what the first pass learned of the consumer') and session_delivery.go:161 ('subscribeHandler's loop').

The merge dropped main's paragraph on the outbox forwarding role-routed events itself (roles.ResolveHolder) and the lane's Nats-Msg-Id rule (key vs event_id); restore it, worded for stored-only forwards.
Name the deleted RequestCoreTo; the stale-holder test's stand-in still answers receipts.
A Respond(nil) subscription nothing reads (Wait skips non-ack replies) and a hand copy of startRoleForward.

The deleted TestPublishRouteStoresOneCopyOfARoleMessageItForwardsTwice was the only pin of the publish route's MsgId: passing "" there still passes the Publish|Role|Forward listener tests. Restore a stored-only case (the first wait fails after the stream stored the copy; assert one copy) and make msgID required.
